GPT-5.5 and similarly labeled incremental products, including GPT-5.6 Sol, are excluded. Astra could qualify if publicly released and established as the GPT-5 successor, but its internal codename and description as the next major model do not by themselves satisfy the rules. Official OpenAI information is primary, supplemented by credible reporting.
